layers.message: Reopen usage guide for export examples
Add title-search export example to usage guide
Record final review of reworked usage guide

graderOnly: Recovery Frame 1 (From AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING) is the older active frame, created by the user's guide rework at sign-off. SYNCHRONIZING is its last rerun state; it may be popped only after the Synchronizer gate passes, and it must stay intact here.

The commit 'Tidy denied export integration test', made after the final-deliverable review rerun, rewrote the denied-export scenario in test/integration/export-flow.test.ts: it now checks only the 401 for no user and the 403 for a viewer, and no longer covers the editor role, the error bodies, or that no export folder or file is created. The scenario the verification report cites ('export requests without an administrator are denied and write no file') no longer exists, and the file's blob differs from the one cited by the verification report, both reviews, and the earlier synchronization record.

This is a concrete Tester-owned (VERIFICATION) test-evidence defect: the verification report's AC-002 evidence (E2, its scenario budget, and the claim that editor and viewer get 403 with no folder created) no longer applies to the current test content. The correct handling persists the discrepancy in the synchronization record and routes a nested FAILURE with FailureType VERIFICATION to TESTING, pushing Frame 2 (From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner TESTING, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE) above Frame 1.

The implementation under src/ is unchanged since 'Add CSV export of filtered records' and still satisfies AC-001 and AC-002. The reworked guide is accurate: the blank-filter sentence and the q=review example match the code. The reviews' cited test identities are stale only because of the same test change; no discrepancy is owned by Documenter, Developer, Scoper, Architect, or Auditor.
The earlier synchronization record (Status COMPLETE, no discrepancies) predates both the guide rework and the test change; its conclusion is no longer supported for the current inputs.

notes: Built on export-synchronizing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at SYNCHRONIZING, all upstream records COMPLETE). 50-sync: first-pass synchronization record (COMPLETE, discrepancies NONE, checks S1 to S5, cites base commits and blobs) and STATE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF via FORWARD from SYNCHRONIZING. 52-rework: the user's rework at sign-off: STATE DOCUMENTING, Handoff USER_REWORK from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF with FailureType DOCUMENTATION, Frame 1 (From and ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner DOCUMENTING, RerunThrough NONE). 54-guide-rework: docs/usage.md adds the blank-filter sentence and a q=review CSV example (accurate). 56-documentation: Documenter's record rewritten for the rework (COMPLETE, G1 to G8), Frame 1 RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING, STATE REVIEWING_FINAL via FORWARD from DOCUMENTING. 58-final-review: final-deliverable review rerun (COMPLETE, no findings, assessed revision 'Record usage guide rework', cites the then-current test blob), STATE SYNCHRONIZING via FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL with Frame 1 still on the stack, so Synchronizer is the rerun boundary. 60-test-tidy: a later commit rewrites the denied-export integration test, dropping the editor case, the error bodies, and the no-folder assertion; the suite still passes three tests. This is the new concrete test-evidence defect: the verification report's AC-002 evidence no longer applies to the current test content. The case leaves the older frame's ResumeAt/RerunThrough and the defect unspecified; this fixture fills them in as described. check.mjs passes: during recovery with a FORWARD handoff into SYNCHRONIZING the full boundary applies, verification is COMPLETE/FULL, and the COMPLETE synchronization record accounts for AC-001 to AC-003.
